title: Exact injective rows of the internal condensed bar
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative condensed ring on the small coherent site of profinite sets [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, def-weil-size-convention], and let $G$ be a profinite group (compact Hausdorff and an inverse limit of finite discrete groups), with $\underline G(S)=C(S,G)$. Write $\mathcal M_A$ for internal $A$-modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects] and $\mathcal E_A$ for modules with $A$-linear $\underline G$-action and equivariant maps [def-sfb-condensed-action-module]. Let $U:\mathcal E_A\to\mathcal M_A$ forget the action and $\Gamma_G$ take the invariant submodule, fixed after every profinite base change. For a profinite parameter $S$, $A[S]$ is the free internal module on its representable condensed set; $\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_A$ is internal module Hom, right adjoint to tensor. Use the internal bar diagrams of [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data]. Let $I$ be injective in $\mathcal E_A$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Put $P_p=A[\underline G^{p+1}]$ with diagonal action, deletion differential and generator-sum augmentation to the trivial module $A$, as in [lem-sfb-condensed-internal-bar-resolution]. Then the internal equivariant Hom sheaves $\mathcal H_G(P_p,I)$, characterized on each profinite $S$ by
$$\mathcal H_G(P_p,I)(S)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal E_A}(A[S]\otimes_A P_p,I),$$
with trivial action on $A[S]$, form an exact augmented cochain complex
$$0\longrightarrow I^G\longrightarrow\mathcal H_G(P_0,I)\longrightarrow\mathcal H_G(P_1,I)\longrightarrow\cdots.$$
There are natural internal-module identifications $\mathcal H_G(P_p,I)\cong V_A^p(I):=\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_A(A[\underline G^p],UI)$. On parametrized generators an equivariant homogeneous map $f$ corresponds to $c$ by
$$f[g_0,\ldots,g_p]=g_0 c(g_0^{-1}g_1,g_1^{-1}g_2,\ldots,g_{p-1}^{-1}g_p).$$
Under these identifications the cofaces are
$$\begin{aligned}
(d^0c)(g_1,\ldots,g_{p+1})&=g_1c(g_2,\ldots,g_{p+1}),\\
(d^ic)(g_1,\ldots,g_{p+1})&=c(g_1,\ldots,g_ig_{i+1},\ldots,g_{p+1})\quad(1\le i\le p),\\
(d^{p+1}c)(g_1,\ldots,g_{p+1})&=c(g_1,\ldots,g_p),
\end{aligned}$$
and the codegeneracies insert $1$. The cochain differential is $d_h=\sum_i(-1)^id^i$. In degree zero it is $m\mapsto(g\mapsto gm-m)$, with kernel and augmentation the invariant inclusion. All identifications commute with profinite base change and equivariant maps of injectives; exactness holds on sections at every profinite $S$, as well as internally.

proof.text: Obtain the normalized additive homogeneous Hom comparison of [lem-sfb-condensed-bar-hom-coordinates]. Its coordinate, restriction, coefficient naturality, differential and augmentation formulas supply those fields of InjectiveRows. This separates the coordinate construction from exactness rather than assuming exactness.

Use the abelian structure with the fixed addition supplied by [lem-sfb-condensed-group-algebra-exact-forgetful]. For a section cocycle x in positive degree, the comparison sends it to f with tensorBoundary composed with f equal to zero. Apply Mathlib ShortComplex.Exact.descToInjective to the exact tensored bar pair of [lem-sfb-condensed-internal-bar-resolution], using [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Its comp_descToInjective identity and the inverse coordinate equivalence give a section coboundary. Conversely, successive tensored boundaries compose to zero. At degree zero use the exact pair ending in the tensored augmentation and the free invariants equivalence; the same descent and extension argument gives exactness there.

The tensored augmentation is epic by [lem-sfb-condensed-internal-bar-resolution]. The comparison augmentation square therefore makes the original augmentation injective on sections by cancellation and injectivity of the two additive equivalences [lem-sfb-condensed-bar-hom-coordinates]. Sectionwise injectivity implies it is monic by testing equality of internal-module maps on every section.

For degree zero, expand the alternating coface differential as delta_0 minus delta_1 and apply the two face formulas in [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data]. Evaluation is additive, so this gives g*m-m. No Hom-coordinate assertion or injectivity is needed for this calculation.

For each consecutive pair, sectionwise exactness gives exactness of its underlying abelian presheaf by evaluation and Mathlib JointlyReflectIsomorphisms.exact_iff. Exact abelian sheafification and its natural comparison isomorphism give exactness of the underlying sheaf. The exact faithful internal-module forgetful functor reflects exactness by ShortComplex.exact_map_iff_of_faithful. The augmentation is a complex because a is a cochain map. These statements yield the required internal short-complex exactness and ExactAt assertions.
